note: WRD3 (#631): the page's figure inventory. Five headline cards (00a-00e), then numbered body figures in themed sections. Each provider and health signal has exactly one home figure for its values and sources; each chart from the chart build belongs to exactly one figure; each measured family of spec #626 names the figures that show it, or the prerequisite it waits for. Numbers are stable: a new figure takes the next unused number.

cards.title: Ready & building
cards.caption: Work supply. Ready should stay at least twice building.

cards.title: Main merges
cards.caption: Merged main PRs per full PST day.

cards.title: CI latency
cards.caption: Workflow created to last job done, median and p90.

cards.title: Runner time
cards.caption: Runner minutes per successful code run.

cards.title: Credit burn
cards.caption: Sampled balance drops over each actual span. Not billing.

figures.title: Ready to merge
figures.caption: One dot per ticket: hours from ready to its first closing merge.
figures.prerequisite: A selected, validated journey artifact (WR2 #2346).

figures.title: Rework
figures.caption: Review rounds, fix rounds and CI reruns, each counted on its own.
figures.prerequisite: Validated review and fix-round facts for a named PR cohort (WR6 #2350).

figures.title: Flow now
figures.caption: Ready and startable work on the board, and this hour's merges by direction.
figures.prerequisite: A selected board graph and complete merge direction metadata (WR2 #2346, WR8 #2352).

figures.title: Push to merge and PR open to merge
figures.caption: Two separate source-backed distributions, never one.
figures.prerequisite: A selected, source-backed push-to-merge artifact and a separate PR-open-to-merge artifact under the chart input contract; neither is collected yet.

figures.title: Stage waits now
figures.caption: Each wait against its loaded limit. Hollow marks are lower bounds.
figures.prerequisite: TL2 journeys and stage waits with TL1's limits (health.stage_health).

figures.title: Stage waits, every stage
figures.caption: All five stages with their limits, misses and held or stale waits.
figures.prerequisite: TL1 and TL2 stage measurements with their settings (WR3 #2347).

figures.title: Weekly faster or slower
figures.caption: This week against last week, on a comparable basis only.
figures.prerequisite: The weekly report (weekly.py) selected as a chart input; it is not selected yet.

figures.title: Main CI now
figures.caption: The latest ci.yml push run on the current main head.
figures.prerequisite: A read of the main head and its ci.yml push run (health.main_ci).

figures.title: CI queue now
figures.caption: Queued and running jobs per exact pool, and how long the queued ones have waited.
figures.prerequisite: A complete, stable ci.yml run and job read with exact pools (health.ci_queue).

figures.title: CI bench
figures.caption: The latest CI window: runs, latency, runner minutes and capacity, in their own units.
figures.prerequisite: Selected CI bench points with their native windows (WR2 #2346).

figures.title: Main red time, steps and reruns
figures.caption: History of red or unknown main, step splits, buckets, reruns and selector escapes.
figures.prerequisite: Selected CI history artifacts for main-red time, step splits, hourly and six-hour buckets, reruns and selector escapes, keeping CI2 and X10 cohorts apart; none are selected yet.

figures.title: Latency maximum, splits and runner count
figures.caption: Worst-case latency, the waiting, setup and running split, and the runners behind capacity.
figures.prerequisite: The CI bench point already carries the latency maximum, the waiting, setup and running split and the runner count, but the War room's CI bench projection (sources.py) keeps only merges, merges per hour, capacity, robot minutes, median and p90; showing them needs that projection to select them.

figures.title: Daily factory usage
figures.caption: One UTC day's merges and usage totals, each in its native unit.
figures.prerequisite: A selected daily factory artifact (WR2 #2346).

figures.title: Claude usage
figures.caption: Tokens, credits and dollars from a complete day export; never converted.
figures.prerequisite: A validated, complete day usage export (WR2 #2346).

figures.title: Cost per merged PR
figures.caption: All-in cost per merged PR, only when every input is present.
figures.prerequisite: A complete USD allocation for one merged-PR cohort (WR4 #2348).

figures.title: Review rounds and findings
figures.caption: CHANGES share, reviewed coverage, finding kinds and user-path calls.
figures.prerequisite: The review-loops report (review_loops.py) selected as a chart input; it is not selected yet.

figures.title: Defects and rollbacks
figures.caption: Defect follow-up, BEFORE and AFTER cohorts and rollbacks.
figures.prerequisite: Sourced defect follow-up, BEFORE/AFTER and rollback records; none are collected yet.

figures.title: Skills eval
figures.caption: Recorded skills-eval runs: coverage, results and cost.
figures.prerequisite: A selected skills-eval manifest, score and coverage record (WR2 #2346).

figures.title: EB6 to EB9
figures.caption: First push to merge, paired replay, bounded live experiment and A/B results.
figures.prerequisite: Each experiment's retained result under its own gate (EB6 #2177, EB7 #2178, EB8 #2179, EB9 #2192).

figures.title: Skill tokens, A/B and promotions
figures.caption: Requests, turns, tokens, required-text bytes, prechecks and promotions.
figures.prerequisite: Selected CF4 run records, A/B, precheck and promotion artifacts; none are selected yet.

figures.title: Bench and signal readiness
figures.caption: Every bench and health signal by state. Grey ones name what they need.
figures.prerequisite: A saved sample.

figures.title: Load, quota and recovery
figures.caption: Fixture load results, API quota and overload, stall alarms and recovery.
figures.prerequisite: Selected FA3 and scale-50 fixture results, HTTP/quota/cache accounting, overload, capacity, stall-alarm and audit/recovery records; none are selected yet.

figures.title: Tests, memory and releases
figures.caption: Test time and resources, memory benches, archived CI cohorts, design ledgers and release checks.
figures.prerequisite: Selected test-resource, memory-bench, CI-cohort, hill-climb ledger and release-check artifacts; none are selected yet.

figures.title: Answer time
figures.caption: How long a request waited for a substantive answer. Request content stays in the cockpit.
figures.prerequisite: Source-linked requests and substantive answers (WR5 #2349).
